name: escalate_to_respiratory_unit
description: Escalate patient to the respiratory or pulmonary intensive care unit for acute respiratory failure or severe pulmonary conditions

respiratory_rate.description: Current respiratory rate in breaths per minute

when_to_use: Patient with refractory hypoxemia despite supplemental oxygen
Acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) requiring advanced ventilation
Severe COPD exacerbation with respiratory failure
Status asthmaticus unresponsive to initial treatment
Massive pulmonary embolism with hemodynamic compromise

examples.query: Patient is on high flow oxygen but sats still dropping to 82%, respiratory rate 34
Severe COPD exacerbation with CO2 retention, needs BiPAP
